chapters.label: Denver, 2021
chapters.text: Denver, 2021, the Nations League final. Mexico lead, late on. Gio Reyna swings in a corner... Weston McKennie soars! It clips the keeper and goes in! Level again!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. McKennie runs at the ball, takes off early. He meets it at the top of his jump.

chapters.label: Forehead first
chapters.text: From the side: he hits it with his forehead. Ochoa touches it... but it still goes in! The USA win the final!

chapters.label: Attack the ball
chapters.text: Attack the ball in the air! Jump early, keep your eyes on it, and hit it with your forehead.
